issues.failure_explanation: Two integrations by parts give (f,v) = e(u,v) + int_{dOmega}[alpha (d_n w)v - (d_n u)v - alpha w (d_n v)] with w = Delta u + (beta/alpha) n^T(H u)n. Substituting the stated boundary conditions into the u-slots (as the text says it does) cancels the test-function term -alpha w (d_n v) identically between the form and the right-hand side, so the variational equation is equivalent only to the PDE plus the single condition alpha d_n w = d_n u (resp. alpha(d_n w - i theta w) = d_n u - i theta u); the second boundary condition is lost.
